value.body: A merchandiser manages an order between a buyer and the factory that makes it. Garment exporters, buying houses, textile mills and retail brands hire them. A day involves emails and calls with buyers, chasing samples and approvals, tracking production against deadlines and sorting out delays.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Tech Textile, or a fashion / apparel degree

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Spreadsheets, ERP systems, email, costing sheets

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join a garment exporter or buying house as a trainee or assistant merchandiser, through campus placement or direct application, and learn on live orders.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: senior merchandiser, sourcing manager, buyer.
Deadlines are tight around shipment dates, and hours can follow buyers' time zones.
Jobs cluster in garment and textile export centres.
